approach: Implement main(api) as a bounded phase machine: restore, survey, close jaws in free space, approach the plate rim, engage, push incrementally, withdraw, verify. Four helpers suffice: observe_local, build_candidates, act_lease, and save_phase. Resolve the supplied task's plate, stove/table reference, and physical front direction from fresh reviews; never equate front with image bottom. Use closed fingers as a pusher, not a grasp. Plan a direct route or two measured side detours around clutter. Reobserve plate displacement after every push burst and replan from that observation. Return completion_proposed and measured evidence, not a claim of native evaluator success. No supplied image coordinates, dimensions, or trajectory become program constants.
observations: Query api.state for budgets, proprioception and own_geometry; use api.review with declared fields and explicit unknown values. Request at most 12 named points and three regions per review: plate rim samples, accessible rim side band, tabletop samples, stove front references, table boundary and relevant obstacles. Check measurement_errors and dictionary membership. Use geo.plane coefficients and geo.circle_xy only after checking identity, horizontality, residuals and angular coverage. Validate boundary depths against interior surfaces; api.plane_point is permitted only for visible landmarks on a validated plane. Retain componentwise uncertainty and physical landmark definitions. After motion invalidate affected geometry; historical projections are not detections. Current partial arcs or corresponding local rim features can establish differential motion without full-outline registration. Record obstruction separately from incomplete visibility.
geometry: Represent the plate by a runtime-validated horizontal circular envelope; rotational symmetry does not require indexed corners. Construct a supported target region in front of the identified stove face, with appropriate lateral overlap and no stove-footprint intersection. Transform own finger bounds with geo.rotation and locate the pad using geo.pad_position. For pusher band [a+t,b+t] and observed rim band [c,d], overlap m is feasible exactly when c+m-b <= t <= d-m-a and 0<m<=min(b-a,d-c). Intersect this with table-clearance constraints. Search geometry-derived headings, three jaw yaws, and endpoints/midpoints of feasible height intervals, rather than imposing a fixed clearance. Separate nominal feasibility, conservative bounds over shared uncertainty dependencies, and observed trial effects. Derive controller tolerances from relevant slack within API limits; an unresolved correction below the achievable deadband needs another configuration or trial, not repeated identical commands.
gate_dependencies: Survey evidence justifies only the next local approach, not the entire future route. Closing requires free-space jaw clearance; descent requires measured local support geometry, usable rim alignment and no observed obstruction. Record incomplete visibility without calling it certified clearance. Engagement requires feasible local contact geometry, not prior proof of contact. The observation-producing push is a short bounded trial. Its independent witness is measured plate motion relative to measured hand motion and the stationary support. Subsequent bursts require current plate position and locally assessed next-segment geometry. Withdrawal uses the acknowledged pusher pose and an assessed separating direction. Completion requires the actual plate/front relation, measured displacement from baseline, support and hand separation after withdrawal; TCP reached alone proves none of these.
bounded_recovery: Every observe_local call, including post-push and final verification, returns valid, contradicted or unknown. Unknown permits two informative replacements: different visible samples/camera, then a locally justified withdrawal or view move and remeasurement. Do not repeat an unchanged occluded request. Rejected geometry tries another candidate; nominally feasible but uncertain contact permits a short trial only with independently acceptable local table and obstacle constraints. Observed obstruction rejects that action; no motion or sideways slip triggers remeasurement and repositioning. Cap execution at three contact configurations, 12 push bursts and four updates per lease. Use ceilings of 20 reviews, 180 Jev calls and 540 native steps, retaining available reserves for withdrawal and verification. Size routes from the smallest planned progress leg; shortening requires recalculating remaining calls. Preserve physical continuity: checkpoint intent and every acknowledged jaw/phase transition before further sensing. Use six records below 8 KB each and an eight-entry diagnostic window. Budget exhaustion, capability gaps and programming errors remain distinct outcomes.
jev_contract: Program features contain source-labelled measurements, uncertainty, phase, candidates, obstacle/visibility distinctions and remaining budgets. api.choose selects only explicitly described candidate identifiers, observe or stop; unavailable selections produce no motion. Each question states its subject and feature fields. act_lease uses api.control or api.drive with exactly x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,gripper questions: negative/decrease, hold/within tolerance, positive/increase in world coordinates; gripper open/close/keep follows the stated objective. Every physical update invokes real Jev; its choices are never silently corrected. Save full api.state before leases and inspect receipts, acknowledged_steps, choices and final state afterward; receipt before/after are position lists. Recompute changing scene features between leases. Stalls and nonconvergence consume finite budgets. Jev interprets processed features, not images or Python; subsequent independent observations establish object effects.
